ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels in the lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels in the central region and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white areas in the outer lobes. A central, roughly triangular black region extends from the peduncle to the median notch. Heavy black mottling and speckling are visible within the white fields. A large, diffuse tan/orange discoid patch is located in the upper-mid region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Amplitudes are highest at the outer margins, featuring sharp, jagged peaks and rounded valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trajectory on the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering sharply to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular, yellowish-brown calcified structures (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Several smaller orange circular spots are scattered across the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, near-vertical dark linear streak is visible on the inner-right lobe. Multiple shorter, fainter linear marks are scattered across the left white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive acorn barnacle colonization on the distal lobe tips. Significant tan/yellowish surface staining present on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe features a large, concentrated area of yellowish-orange pigmentation that is absent on the left lobe.
